correctness.rationale: For each site, source Eq. (26) gives independent Bernoulli occupation bits, hence diagonal local purity equals product_i[pij^2+(1-pij)^2]. With xij=2pij(1-pij) in [0,1], 1-product_i(1-xij)<=sum_i xij; after summing over sites with sum_j pij=1 this is at most 2 sum_i(1-sum_j pij^2)<=2M. Substitution into the source Eq. (24) gives E_MW <=(2^M/(2^M-1))*2M/(2t+M+1). All M and all site profiles allowed, fixed-M decay O(t^-1). Independent exact rational enumerations M=1..4 cross-checked purity/finite inequalities; analytic factorization proves arbitrary M.
